_precacheMaxBytesComment: PR #353 integrated with #356-358 (2026-09-06): preserve both bounded allowances over the 4840192-byte baseline: +2048 bytes for shared inactivity and +67840 bytes for the offline clinical library. Auth monitoring and calculators stay cached; documents remain outside precache under docs/ and templates/. No new exclusions or relaxed warning bands. Auth evidence/rollback: docs/AUTH_ACCESS_MODEL.md; library evidence: src/features/clinical-library/README.md. assetPatternBudgets._comment: Browser ExcelJS is served as a runtime asset instead of a duplicated Vite chunk. This ceiling keeps the measured ~948 KB asset near the warning band so payload drift stays visible without blocking the current release.

startupChunkBudgets.label: firebase-core
startupChunkBudgets._comment: Raised from 320000 to 350000. The chunk sat at 91% of the older ceiling with Firebase SDK 12; minor Firebase patch releases were landing on the edge of the budget. Upstream-controlled size, so give explicit headroom. Revisit if utilization exceeds 93%.

startupChunkBudgets.label: app-authenticated-shell
startupChunkBudgets._comment: PR #374 moved startup behavior in sync notifications. PR #384 adds typed Eloisa page-state and freshness presentation; the reviewed ceiling rises by 2000 bytes without moving clinical readers into startup.

chunkPatternBudgets._comment: Kept in sync with the firebase-core startup budget above.
